units.title: SG-5.4.2 BootScene preloads only planned assets with fallback texture
Act: Add BootScene.preload driven by planPreload
Act: Resolve texture keys and generate fallback in BootScene
Verify: BootScene.preload loads only planned assets

tests.name: loads the referenced, manifest-known asset with its manifest path
tests.title: BootScene.preload loads the referenced asset once with its manifest path
tests.scenario: Given a scene referencing objects/bed and a manifest that declares it, When preload() runs, Then load.image is called once with ('objects/bed', 'assets/worlds/the-boys-room/furniture/bed.svg')
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootScenePreload.test.ts

tests.name: never loads a manifest asset that the scene does not reference
tests.title: BootScene.preload does not load a manifest asset the scene never references
tests.scenario: Given a manifest declaring objects/desk that the scene does not reference, When preload() runs, Then load.image is never called with objects/desk
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootScenePreload.test.ts

tests.name: never loads a referenced asset that is missing from the manifest
tests.title: BootScene.preload does not load a referenced asset that is missing from the manifest
tests.scenario: Given a scene referencing objects/ghost that the manifest does not declare, When preload() runs, Then load.image is never called with objects/ghost
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootScenePreload.test.ts

tests.name: warns about the unknown asset reference by id
tests.title: BootScene.preload warns with the id of an unknown asset reference
tests.scenario: Given a scene referencing objects/ghost that the manifest does not declare, When preload() runs, Then console.warn is called with a message containing objects/ghost
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootScenePreload.test.ts

units.title: Verify: Fallback texture and key resolution

tests.id: bootSceneFallback > resolveKey returns asset id when known and not failed
tests.name: BootScene resolveKey fallback > returns the asset id itself when the manifest knows it and it has not failed
tests.title: BootScene resolveKey returns the asset id itself when the manifest knows it and it has not failed
tests.scenario: Given a BootScene preloaded with objects/bed in the manifest, When resolveKey('objects/bed') is called, Then it returns 'objects/bed'

tests.id: bootSceneFallback > resolveKey returns fallback for unknown id
tests.name: BootScene resolveKey fallback > returns the fallback key for an id the manifest does not know
tests.title: BootScene resolveKey returns the fallback key for an id the manifest does not know
tests.scenario: Given a BootScene preloaded with the manifest, When resolveKey('nope') is called, Then it returns 'fallback:missing'

tests.id: bootSceneFallback > resolveKey returns fallback after loaderror
tests.name: BootScene resolveKey fallback > returns the fallback key once the loader reports the asset as failed
tests.title: BootScene resolveKey returns the fallback key once the loader reports the asset as failed
tests.scenario: Given the loaderror handler registered via load.on has reported 'objects/bed' as failed, When resolveKey('objects/bed') is called, Then it returns 'fallback:missing'

tests.id: bootSceneFallback > effectContext dust particles use fallback key
tests.name: createPhaserEffectContext fallback key usage > passes the resolved fallback key as the dust particle texture
tests.title: Phaser effect context passes the resolved fallback key as the dust particle texture
tests.scenario: Given an effect context whose key resolver returns 'fallback:missing' and a fake scene whose add.particles returns a chainable setDepth, When a dust effect is created, Then the particles factory receives 'fallback:missing' as its texture key and the emitter depth is set

units.title: REQ · BootScene preloads only the planned assets
REQ · Texture keys resolve through resolveTextureKey with a fallback texture
